sentences.text: G.M.N.R. vs . Shankri Devi & Ors on 13 July, 2023

Author: Virender Singh
Bench: Virender Singh
G.M.N.R. Vs. Shankri Devi & ors
 .
 Cmp(M) No. 172 of 2022
13.7.2023

Present: Mr. Vir Bahadur Verma, Advocate, Central
 Government Counsel, for the
 applicant/appellant.
Mr. Dheeraj K. Vashishta, Advocate, for respondents/nonapplicants No. 2 to 6.

Mr. Mohinder Zaraick and Mr. H.S. Rawat, Additional Advocates General with Ms. Avni Kochhar Mehta and Ms. Leena Guleria, Deputy Advocates General, for respondent No. 8.
CMP(M)s No. 819 of 2023 & 820 of 2019

By way of present applications, filed under Order 22 Rule 4 read with Section 151 of the CPC and Section 5 of the Limitation Act, the applicant/appellant has prayed that legal representatives of deceased respondent No. 1, Late Smt. Shankri Devi, who as per averments contained in the application, expired on 24.2.2019 be ordered to be brought on record,
after condoning the delay, since the present application has been filed after the prescribed period of limitation.

At this stage, it has been pointed out that the legal representatives of deceased respondent No. 1,
namely Ranjodh Singh, Pitamber Singh and Jatinder Singh, are already on record, as respondents No. 4 to 6.

In such situation, considering the fact that the present appeal has been filed against the award,
dated 7.2.2018, which is an LAC matter, name of deceased respondent No. 1, whose legal representatives are already .
G.M.N.R. vs . Shankri Devi & Ors on 13 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136838786/
1 on record, is ordered to be deleted from the array of parties.
The necessary correction be carried out in the memo of parties.
The applications are, thus, disposed of.
The application is allowed with a direction to the applicant to do the needful within a period of four weeks.
The application is, thus, disposed of.
By way of present application, the applicant/appellant has sought condonation of delay, in filing the present appeal, which, as per averments made in the application, is 582 days.

The application is duly supported by an affidavit of Deputy Chief Engineer, ConstructionI,
Northern Railway, Chandigarh.
Although, reply to the application has not been filed, but the prayer made in the application has been opposed by learned counsel appearing for the non applicants/appellants.
However, considering the fact that the matter had to be dealt with at various levels, before filing the present appeal, the delay in filing the present appeal, is ordered to be condoned.

The application is,
thus, disposed of.

RFA No. ______________ .
Be registered.
Admit.
Post admission notice be issued to respondent No. 7, on steps being taken within a week, returnable for 28.9.2023.
CMP No. _____________  r Be registered.

Since the accompanying appeal stands admitted and the same shall take sufficient long time for its disposal, therefore, the impugned award dated 7.2.2018, passed in LAC Petition RBT No. 35/16/13, titled as "Shankri Devi versus Land Acquisition Collector (Railways) & others", by the learned District Judge, Una, is ordered to be stayed, subject to deposit of entire amount of compensation, with upto date interest, within a period G.M.N.R. vs . Shankri Devi & Ors on 13 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136838786/
2 of 10 weeks from today.
